On its Q2 2026 earnings call, management raised the full-year organic revenue growth outlook to 5%, reflecting accelerating benefits from the combined entity's scale and combined client relationships.
key_facts: $900M in IPG-OMC merger cost synergies targeted for 2026
IPG merger closed November 2025
Organic revenue growth outlook raised to 5% for FY2026
Combined revenue exceeds $6.6B per quarter

headline: Microsoft Azure growth of 39-40% and FY2027 CapEx guidance in focus as Q4 FY2026 results loom
summary: Investor attention ahead of Microsoft's Q4 FY2026 earnings (July 29) centers on Azure cloud segment growth, guided at 39-40% in constant currency, and capital expenditure trajectory. Q4 CapEx is expected to exceed $40 billion, partly due to higher component pricing and finance lease impact. FY2027 CapEx guidance will be closely watched given the Nasdaq selloff driven by AI spending fears.
key_facts: Azure revenue growth guided at +39-40% constant currency for Q4 FY2026
Q4 CapEx expected >$40B (includes ~$5B from higher component pricing)
FY2027 CapEx guidance is key watchpoint for investors
Q4 FY2026 revenue consensus: ~$87.67B
FY2026 consensus revenue range: $324-327 billion

headline: Silgan Holdings releases Q2 2026 earnings results on July 29
summary: Silgan Holdings, a manufacturer of consumer goods packaging, is scheduled to release its second-quarter 2026 earnings results on July 29, 2026. Silgan is a packaging company serving food and beverage brands.
key_facts: Silgan Holdings Q2 2026 results scheduled for July 29, 2026
